title: The guard reads a git command inside a python3 -c, sh -c or bash -c body, or a PowerShell & ('git') call
why: Lane guard-split-git-word's red rows (43fac17a3, 04:54 CST Nov 8) found that a force push inside a python3 -c, sh -c or bash -c body, or a PowerShell & ('git') call, is not read even unsplit. The #1593 incident's own form, python3 -c with 'gi'+'t', falls in this gap, so Claude has hit it.
note: Fix: the guard reads the body of python3 -c, sh -c and bash -c, and a PowerShell & ('git') call, as commands; red rows first. Rides in the lane that found it (item 386 b), after guard-split-git-word. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 04:57 CST Nov 8.
